breve: Contains functions to modify texture coordinates (uv) to be used within the visual shader graph.
descricao: UV functions are similar to Vector2 functions, but the input port of this node uses the shader's UV value by default.

propriedades.desc: A function to be applied to the texture coordinates.

constantes.desc: Translates uv by using scale and offset values using the following formula: uv = uv + offset * scale. uv port is connected to UV built-in by default.
Scales uv by using scale and pivot values using the following formula: uv = (uv - pivot) * scale + pivot. uv port is connected to UV built-in by default.
Represents the size of the 'Function' enum.
